title.narrative: Strengthening Open Science and STI Ecosystems in South-East Europe

description.narrative: This initiative will strengthen Open Science and Science, Technology and Innovation (STI) ecosystems in South-East Europe by promoting inclusive access to scientific knowledge, fostering collaboration among researchers, policymakers, educators, and innovation actors, and enhancing public engagement with science. Through capacity development, knowledge exchange, and the sharing of good practices, the activity will support efforts to make science more accessible, transparent, and responsive to societal needs. Particular attention will be given to science literacy, citizen science, gender equality in science, and the participation of young scientists and innovators. Deliverables will include a regional workshop, practical knowledge resources, and recommendations for strengthening Open Science and STI ecosystems across the region.
